asks: Pause new flyovers and road-widening (H-CITI, SRDP) until their impact is assessed
Roll bus and Metro fares back to pre-2022 levels
Bus-priority lanes and safer crossings near bus stops
Pooled feeder buses from Metro/MMTS to HITEC City, Madhapur and Raidurg, co-funded by IT companies
Officials and leaders to use public transport
next: Organisers plan to hand the printed petition to the Governor, the CM and senior officials and ask for talks.

stat.l: sign-ups in the first two days (Oct 9)

title: Let's Un-Choke Hyderabad: pause flyovers, fix public transport
what: An online petition asking the Telangana government to stop adding roads for cars and invest in buses, Metro, MMTS and walking instead.
who: A group of urban planners, transport professionals and residents (founding member: Natasha Ranarathnam, Somajiguda)
